title: Update of National Address System
why: Q2: reports implementation under way with pilot zones on Mahe, Praslin and La Digue and completion expected by end-2026; names emergency services, utilities and e-commerce as intended users (Q3, Q4).

title: Cabinet Business, Wednesday 1st April 2026
why: Q2: describes the National Addressing System Bill, a National Addressing Database Unit, postcode structures and digital numbering as a nationwide framework, not yet a service in operation.

title: Sistemm ladres lakaz
why: Q2: says the house-address project had nearly completed its starting district, Beau Vallon; a local rollout, not national coverage (Q3).

title: Cabinet Business, Thursday 25th July 2024
why: Q2: records Cabinet approval of the S42 addressing and postcode system, pilot testing in Beau Vallon and rollout planned for March 2025.

title: Seychelles to introduce national addressing system, pilot rollout planned for March 2025
why: Q2: explains the proposed four-digit district, sub-district and zone codes, house identification and GIS app, as an introduction and pilot (Q3, Q4).

title: News Centre
publisher: Ministry of Local Government and Community Affairs
why: Q2: reports district administrations mapping roads for national addressing system implementation, i.e. preparatory work (Q3).

title: DICT What's New: New online tools to help push Seychelles towards digital era
why: Q2: describes Sey-Address as a concept for registering an address as proof of address; does not show a live national register (Q4).

title: Les Seychelles vont introduire un système d'adressage national, déploiement pilote prévu pour mars 2025
why: Q2: French edition confirming the proposed S42 codes, house numbering and GIS link, with pilot rollout planned (Q3, Q4).
